gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate, and the source HL7 Specimen from a Normally Sterile Site value set is not implemented. General test-name alternatives that require SNOMED or HL7 sterile-site specimen linkage are omitted from IPD-R1 through IPD-R3 and IPD-R9; coded sterile-site-specific test-name alternatives remain modeled
